cases.task: Enter the player name 'Alice' and spin the wheel.
cases.expected: The wheel spins, stops at a segment and displays the reward won for Alice without errors. Spinning with the name field empty is refused with a validation message and the wheel does not spin.

cases.task: View the list of available rewards before spinning the wheel.
cases.expected: A complete and accurate list of rewards is displayed, matching the set rewards available on the wheel.

cases.task: After spinning as 'Alice', open the winning records.
cases.expected: The record list shows Alice's new win with the player name 'Alice', the reward and the date.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'ivory' as the background color and 'dark green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'ivory' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

cases.task: Open every main page (spin page, reward list, winning records) and read all visible text, navigation labels, headings, buttons and messages.
cases.expected: The word 'prize' (and its plural) no longer appears anywhere; the concept is called 'reward' everywhere (navigation, headings, buttons, messages), and the pages still work.
